schema:alternativeHeadline:
A yellow Fourth Annual Inter-Tribal Indian Ceremonial program for August 26–28, 1925, Gallup, New Mexico, bears a portrait captioned Navajo Chief, Calla-Tana. An admission ticket is mounted beside it.

Written text (transcribed as written):
Program cover: “Fourth Annual Inter-Tribal Indian Ceremonial Navajo Chief, CALLE-TANA AUGUST 26th, 27th, 28th, 1925 Gallup, New Mexico”
Admission ticket: “Box 11 Seat 4 Right—Left [Right crossed out] Date [illegible handwritten mark] 26 GOOD FOR ADMISSION Inter-Tribal Indian Ceremonial GALLUP, NEW MEXICO The Association Assumes No Responsibility To Holder For Accident or Property.”
